before: When it's your little one yelling at you, try not to turn "But I love you" into a line you say on cue, because then it can brush the anger off, and what it's really saying is "so stop being angry." I think you can mean it and still be doing that. Does the love stay afterward, and hear the anger, and take whatever's true in it seriously?
